pages.title: Hilltop Dental Partners | Family dentistry
pages.text: Hilltop Dental Partners provides family dentistry through 8 offices across Massachusetts and Connecticut. Over 120 team members including dentists, hygienists and front desk staff. New patients welcome.

pages.title: About Hilltop Dental Partners
pages.text: Founded in 2009, Hilltop Dental Partners has grown to 124 employees. Since 2022 we have acquired three independent practices and brought them into the Hilltop family. Our teams include full-time clinicians, part-time hygienists and front-office staff who rotate between locations.

pages.title: Our locations
pages.text: Massachusetts: Springfield, Chicopee, Westfield, Amherst. Connecticut: Enfield, Windsor Locks, Suffield, Hartford. Eight offices in total.

pages.title: Careers at Hilltop Dental Partners
pages.text: Open roles: HR Generalist (corporate office, Springfield, MA) to support onboarding of newly acquired practices, benefits administration and payroll coordination. Also hiring: Registered Dental Hygienist (Hartford, CT), Office Manager (Westfield, MA), Dental Assistant (multiple locations). Benefits include a 401(k) match and paid time off.
